groups.defect: The async legacy goroutines in Create, Update, Delete and DeleteCollection derive their context from the request ctx, which is cancelled when the handler returns, so legacy writes can be aborted and legacy storage drifts (s_52fd068c also asks for a deep copy of obj before the goroutine starts).
groups.rationale: All three report the same request-context cancellation in the same four goroutines and propose context.WithoutCancel as the fix.

groups.defect: Metrics are recorded under the wrong series or label: DeleteCollection's legacy goroutine calls recordStorageDuration (line 166), the Create and Update storage-failure paths call recordLegacyDuration (lines 45 and 129), and Delete's success path passes name instead of options.Kind (line 106). Separately, Delete attaches d.Log rather than the enriched log to ctx (line 97).
groups.rationale: s_6c9586da reports all of the metric mislabeling defects that the other members report one at a time. s_7f4a71cc and s_56f46701 combine the line-106 label defect with the line-97 logger defect, which chains in s_62248494.
